description: Black to kill. White has the shape of an L with one extra eye-stone. Find the throw-in that destroys both potential eyes, then follow up to capture.

H1.comment: Vital point. The throw-in attacks both potential eyes (J1 and G1) at once.

E1.comment: Remove white's last outside liberty. White is forced to capture, but the resulting shape has only one eye.

H1.comment: Throw in again. White has only one eye and no outside liberties - the whole group is captured.

J1.comment: Wrong direction. White captures with H1 and the resulting shape has clean eyes at J1 and G1.

G1.comment: Wrong direction. White captures with H1 and the resulting shape has clean eyes at J1 and G1.

E1.comment: Outside before inside fails - white plays the vital point H1 and lives with two clean eyes.
